name: Camera store
responsibility: Keeps the live camera, its last resting camera, the moving flag and subscribers outside React
description: Only subscribed presentation readers redraw on a camera change. While a hand moves it or a flight holds it, the rest stays where it was. The surface reads moving to keep its transform layer; SemanticDiagram reads rest.scale for the near/far swap and traffic resumes from the same rest. This is presentation state, never a copy of board meaning.
